hypothesis: Visit adjacent heads first at a fixed query tile, increasing locality of query rows and shared KV/mask accesses. Keep the original compressed FlashAttention template and all per-output arithmetic unchanged.
change: Both roles use the same original pipeline object and untransposed dispatch.
inputs: Deterministic finite F32 queries and F16 shared K/V, per-head sinks, full production causal window/compressed masks; every production chunk shape and both KV-padding paths.
checks: Independent CPU mask/block/padding verification; full bitwise FP32 outputs and finite/nondegenerate output checks after every warm-up pair and timed pair; destination guard regions; invariant output checksum. Retain all failures and timings.
screening: Report AB and BA A/A ratios and first/second-run ratios. No candidate verdict or engine claim. All full-output, guard, CPU preparation and input immutability checks remain required.
